name: faith
overview: Faith is the essential means by which believers relate to God, characterized by confident trust in His reality and His promises, as Hebrews 11:1 and 11:6 affirm. It is both the foundation for pleasing God and the instrument by which Christians live daily, walking by faith rather than sight (2 Corinthians 5:7). Faith arises through hearing the Word of God (Romans 10:17) and involves active trust in God’s power and provision (Mark 11:22; Matthew 21:22). This trust is not mere intellectual assent but a heartfelt reliance that sustains believers through all circumstances.
